verdict.rationale: Workable's own Workable Agent is described as running the top of the funnel (sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate) and handing back a shortlist, which is a product-native autonomous background process. However, nothing documents users configuring their own automations, triggers or schedules. Webhooks and the API are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, documented triggers or recurring schedules, controls and monitoring for background runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
